args: token=$(gh auth token 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$token" ]; then export GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN="$token"; elif [ -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ]; then export GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN="$GITHUB_TOKEN"; fi; exec npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-github

d="${TEAM_OPS_ROOT:-$PWD}"; while [ "$d" != "/" ]; do f="$d/mcp/discord/src/index.js"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec node "$f"; fi; d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; echo 'discord mcp: mcp/discord/src/index.js not found (set TEAM_OPS_ROOT or run from within team-ops)' >&2; exit 1
